title: Synthetic (Fused) Mullite and Alumina Grains for Refractory Industry
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies the requirements of synthetic mullite and alumina grains in fused forms used for the manufacture of shaped or unshaped refractories.
clause_3_terminology: Mullite and Alumina Grains for Refractory Industry

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
